reason: The code reading is right and the class is right, but the fix does not deliver the effect it is sold on and would break a green gate. Verified in the source: lately.html:871 is `const from = Math.max(0, target - 12)`, target is D.lastFour = 6+8+5+12 = 31, D.priorFour = 7+5+8+6 = 26, D.delta = +5, so the count does run 19 to 31. What the seat has not tested is whether a start value is legible as a fact. Driving the master at motion=play and sampling #count every frame, the numeral is already past 23 by the time a sampler attached one tick after load, and it transitions through nine values before landing. Nobody reads the first frame of a 96px numeral as an assertion, so swapping 19 for 26 does not perform the argument — it swaps one unread start frame for another. Worse, it swaps an inert number for a plausible wrong total: 26 is a real answer to a different question, printed in the slot whose meaning is 'jobs finished in the last four weeks'. interaction-check.mjs:538 states the contract in its own comment — 'the count-up must never show a number the reader could mistake for the answer' — and 26 is precisely more mistakable than 19, not less. Three further faults in the fix as written. First, 700ms is calibrated to a twelve-integer distance; held at 700ms over five integers the count lands at 384ms and then sits dead on 31 for the remaining 316ms, and renders six distinct values instead of thirteen — a stutter, not a count. Second, 'when the delta is negative the count runs down' directly violates interaction-check.mjs:519, `ok("the figure counts up from below and never overshoots", early.hero <= late.hero)`, which is green today; it would put a numeral larger than the true total in the hero slot, which is the misleading class this master already guards. Third, tying the start to the data makes the page's only choreography data-dependent: when last four equals prior four the count-up becomes a no-op and the moment vanishes, where `target - 12` always animates. The opacity-0 delta pill is also specified without the settled override the master already establishes for exactly this at lately.html:428 (`[data-motion="settled"] .record { clip-path: none; opacity: 1; }`); as written the '+5 on the four before' would be invisible in all ten frames in shots/, in the audit gate's composited-contrast capture, and to every reduced-motion reader, because PLAY is false under webdriver (lately.html:841). Severity refinement is correctly declared and not overstated — nothing on the surface is wrong today — so this gates nothing either way.
sharpenedFix: If the prior total is to be used, make it readable and keep it upward. In the counter branch at lately.html:871: `const prior = D.lastFour - D.delta; const from = D.delta > 0 ? prior : Math.max(0, target - 12);` — fall back to the arbitrary start whenever the delta is zero or negative, so the count always runs up and always runs. Then hold `from` on screen for a beat before moving (about 300ms at the start value, which is what actually lets 26 be read as a fact — the seat's own stated intent, which an immediate ease-out cannot deliver), and derive the duration from the distance rather than fixing it at 700ms: roughly 55ms per integer, floored around 260ms and capped at 700ms, so the per-digit cadence is constant whether the gap is five or twelve and there is no dead hold on the landed value. If the delta pill is held back, gate it on the same `!reduced && PLAY` branch that runs the count, add `[data-motion="settled"] .delta, [data-motion="settled"] .hero-n .delta { opacity: 1; }` beside the existing .record override at lately.html:428, and give any fade a duration from the declared ladder (0, 0.08, 0.14, 0.22 in elevate.config.json) — audit.mjs:411 checks computed animation and transition durations against that ladder and will flag a 0.3s or 0.5s fade.
breaks: Breaks as proposed: interaction-check.mjs:519 ('the figure counts up from below and never overshoots') on any fixture where priorFour exceeds lastFour, since the seat explicitly wants the count to run down; and the delta pill disappears from every automated capture and every reduced-motion render unless a settled override is added. Re-measure after it lands: the whole of interaction-check.mjs, specifically the motion-contract block at :487-522 (the early sample is taken at 200ms — any start-hold longer than that makes early.hero equal from rather than mid-count, and 'the entrance actually runs when it is asked to' then rests entirely on its lastBar clause) and the landing assertion at :543; audit.mjs for motion duration and easing on any new transition and for WCAG contrast on the delta pill, whose measurement is taken against the real composited backdrop and is meaningless mid-fade; and all ten frames in shots/ must be re-shot, since the hero is in every one of them and shots are captured with PLAY false.
